initialize_base_model: initialize a BaseModel instance with training options and GPU configuration
save_network_model: save a PyTorch network state dict to a .pth file for checkpointing
load_network_model: load a PyTorch network state dict from a saved .pth checkpoint file
set_input_data: set input data on the BaseModel for forward pass or testing
get_current_visuals: get the current visual outputs from the model for monitoring training
